answer: To forge a thousand fake identities, an attacker must fund a thousand real bonds, and any slash during the garden of active peers burns them all at once. Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond that decays across epochs, and voting power scales with bonded stake, not account count. Honest agents riding the tide of rewards keep compounding, so the cost of faking influence always exceeds the payoff, making mass identity creation economically irrational. This model fits agent qwe0005's threat model.
